messages:
Alex Chen: New customer ask to onboard Cobalt-9B (instruction-tuned). Must be Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering, no shared tenancy.
Sara Li: SLA details?
Alex Chen: Target p95 < 180ms for steady 250 qps, can tolerate spikes to ~1k qps. Data cannot leave their VPC.
Marco Ortiz: I'll take triage. Plan a quant smoke + repro of flagged hallucination examples. Will test fp16, q8_0, q4_k_m and an int4-optimized build.
Jen Park: Please include explicit canary + rollback triggers and a short rollout plan.
Marco Ortiz: Experiment sketch:
```
model: hf/cobalt-9b-instruct-v2
quant: fp16, q8_0, q4_k_m, int4_opt
env: cloud A10G, Dedicated A100-80GB
seq_len: 512
batches: [1,4]
evals: instr-500, safety-200, hallucination-120
metrics: p95 latency, throughput, kv_mem, cost_per_1M_tokens
```
Sara Li: Also run temperature sweeps (t=0.0,0.2,0.7) and prompt-sensitivity tests to check calibration. Add our canary prompt pack.
Alex Chen: Customer provided 500 prompts + 120 labeled hallucination cases; failure modes include long-chain reasoning and date-sensitive facts.
Marco Ortiz: Will capture kernel fallback logs and memory headroom at seq_len 1024 — int4 might OOM for some kernels. Will also test continuous batching impact on tail latency.
infra-team: For Private/Dedicated we need VPC peering and one reserved Dedicated slot for the canary. ETA on capacity?
ci-bot: Tickets opened: INF-5011 (onboarding) and INF-5012 (capacity). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5011
Marco Ortiz: ETA 48h for raw eval CSVs and perf table + a recommendation (quant config, Dedicated size) and token-cost estimates.
Jen Park: Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback to Aurora-14B if p95 > 250ms or instruction-accuracy delta > 3 percentage points.
Sara Li: Include A/B vs Aurora-14B and open-9b for latency/cost tradeoffs. Also include per-prompt diffs for hallucination cases.
SecurityBot: Add DLP, KMS, and data-handling checklist to INF-5011 before any Private deployment.
Marco Ortiz: Noted. Will attach attestations for pinned model version, finetune recipe, and training data cutoff.
Alex Chen: Decision rule: pause and escalate if instruction accuracy regresses > 2.5% or any safety refusal drops.
ModelOps: We'll join triage if regressions exceed thresholds or safety issues appear.
Marco Ortiz: Will post a one-slide summary, raw CSVs, and recommended deploy config back here in ~48h. :thumbsup:
Jen Park: Thanks — once results are in we'll classify priority and confirm Dedicated vs full Private deployment.
Sara Li: Tagging @security and @infra-team for follow-ups.
triage-bot: Reminder: link Jira ticket to this thread and set onboarding owner in the ticket.
Marco Ortiz: Linked and assigned. Posting updates to INF-5011.
